input-offset.name: Input offset (frames)
input-offset.description: Shift every macro input by this many 240Hz frames (positive = later). Adjust if the exported macro desyncs at the very start of a run.

solver-seed.name: Solver seed
solver-seed.description: 0 = use a new random seed every run. Set a fixed number to make the search fully reproducible: same level + same seed always produces the same result.

max-idle-seconds.name: Auto-stop after idle (s)
max-idle-seconds.description: Stop the search if no new progress is made for this many seconds. 0 = disabled (search until solved or stopped manually).
